### 1. Architecture Overview
The Prometheus `model/labels` package is the foundational label representation used across the observability stack. It provides multiple build-tag-selectable implementations of `labels.Labels`, with the current default being a sorted slice of `Label` structs (“slicelabels”), plus alternative string-encoded (“stringlabels”) and symbol-table (“dedupelabels”) implementations. Builders (`Builder`, `ScratchBuilder`) allow mutation and construction of `Labels` while preserving sorted order and avoiding excessive allocations. Downstream projects (e.g., Grafana Mimir/Cortex, Loki, Tempo) import this package and assume `Labels` is a slice, iterating, indexing, or performing unsafe conversions. Changing `Labels` to a new named struct with private fields and accessor methods will break any code that treats it as a slice or performs unsafe pointer conversions.

End-to-end flow today:
- Core type definitions and operations live in Prometheus `model/labels` (slice-based in `labels_slicelabels.go`, string-based in `labels_stringlabels.go`, dedupe in `labels_dedupelabels.go`, with common helpers in `labels_common.go`, matching in `matcher.go`, and tests in `labels_test.go`).
- Downstream consumers:
  - Grafana Mimir: interop via unsafe conversions (`pkg/mimirpb/compat_stringlabels.go`), label fixups for slicelabel builds (`pkg/streamingpromql/testutils/compat_fixup_labels_slice.go`), label hashers and builders in Loki (`pkg/logql/log/labels*.go`), and label deduplication utilities (`pkg/util/limiter/series_labels_deduplicator.go`).
  - Tempo: pooled Prometheus label builders (`modules/generator/registry/builder.go`).

Any change to `Labels` shape must be accompanied by refactors in these consumers to use new accessors rather than direct slice operations or unsafe pointer casts.

### 2. Detailed Analysis
#### Prometheus core
- `model/labels/labels_slicelabels.go` (repo: prometheus) defines `type Labels []Label` (sorted slice) and all operations: hashing (`Hash`, `HashForLabels`, `HashWithoutLabels` ~L74-143), filtering (`MatchLabels`, `BytesWithLabels/BytesWithoutLabels` ~L55-192), getters (`Get`, `Has` ~L201-220), duplicate detection (`HasDuplicateLabelNames` ~L222-234), empty removal (`WithoutEmpty` ~L236-253), builders (`Builder.Reset`, `Builder.Labels` ~L397-435), and scratch builders (`ScratchBuilder.Add/Labels/Overwrite` ~L482-517). Changing `Labels` to a struct with private fields will break all code that treats it as `[]Label`. (metadata)
- `model/labels/labels_common.go` defines `Label` struct and shared helpers, including `Builder` that wraps base `Labels` and provides `Set`, `Del`, `Keep`, `Range`, etc. This also assumes `Labels` is slice-addressable and sortable. (metadata)
- Alternative implementations:
  - `model/labels/labels_stringlabels.go`: string-encoded `Labels` with its own `Builder`/`ScratchBuilder`, hashing and filtering APIs. (metadata)
  - `model/labels/labels_dedupelabels.go`: symbol-table/varint encoded `Labels` with builders. (metadata)
- Tests in `model/labels/labels_test.go` cover all operations assuming slice semantics and will fail after the shape change. (metadata)
- `model/labels/matcher.go` consumes `Labels` via API (matchers), less likely to break if public methods remain. (metadata)

#### Grafana Mimir (imports prometheus/model/labels)
- `pkg/mimirpb/compat_stringlabels.go`: Uses unsafe pointer cast `FromLabelAdaptersToLabels` (~L14-17) to treat protobuf `[]LabelAdapter` as `labels.Labels` and uses `ScratchBuilder` to build labels with zero allocations (~L31-37). Will break because `Labels` is no longer a slice and pointer layouts change. (metadata)
- `pkg/streamingpromql/testutils/compat_fixup_labels_slice.go`: Fixes nil metrics by assigning `labels.EmptyLabels()` for slicelabel builds; relies on `labels.Labels` concrete type. Needs update to call new constructor/accessors. (metadata)
- `pkg/util/limiter/compat_stringlabels_test.go`: Uses reflection/unsafe to compare internal string data pointers of two `labels.Labels` instances; assumes slice layout. Must be rewritten to use public accessors or be removed. (metadata)
- `pkg/util/limiter/series_labels_deduplicator.go`: Deduplicates `labels.Labels`, stores and returns them; if it iterates or copies assuming slices, needs refactor to accessor-based iteration. (metadata)

#### Loki (imports prometheus/model/labels)
- `pkg/logql/log/labels.go`: Core label management; imports `github.com/prometheus/prometheus/model/labels`. Internally stores and hashes `labels.Labels`, uses builders and maps; must replace any direct iteration or assumption of slice layout with accessor methods. (metadata)
- Build-tag-specific hashers:
  - `pkg/logql/log/labels_slicelabels.go`: Uses `labels.Labels` directly for hashing; assumes slicelabel build. Must switch to new API. (metadata)
  - `pkg/logql/log/labels_stringlabels.go`: Uses `labels.StableHash` on `labels.Labels`; likely OK if API retained but must avoid direct indexing. (metadata)

#### Tempo (imports prometheus/model/labels)
- `modules/generator/registry/builder.go`: Uses `labels.Builder` from Prometheus directly, pooled via `sync.Pool`. Should continue working if Builder API stays, but any direct slice operations on returned `labels.Labels` must be updated. (metadata)

### 3. Relevant Files
| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| prometheus | model/labels/labels_slicelabels.go | Core slice-based `Labels` type; defines hashing, filtering, builders that assume `Labels` is `[]Label`. Changing shape breaks all direct uses. |
| prometheus | model/labels/labels_common.go | Defines `Label` and shared helpers/Builder APIs relying on slice semantics. |
| prometheus | model/labels/labels_stringlabels.go | Alternative implementation; must be kept in sync with new struct API or retired; tests will break if interfaces change. |
| prometheus | model/labels/labels_dedupelabels.go | Symbol-table implementation; must align with new struct API. |
| prometheus | model/labels/labels_test.go | Tests assume slice layout; will need updates to new struct and accessors. |
| prometheus | model/labels/matcher.go | Consumes `Labels` via public API; ensure compatibility with new struct. |
| mimir | pkg/mimirpb/compat_stringlabels.go | Unsafe pointer casts between protobuf `[]LabelAdapter` and `labels.Labels`; will break when `Labels` is no longer a slice. |
| mimir | pkg/streamingpromql/testutils/compat_fixup_labels_slice.go | Fixes nil metrics by assigning `labels.EmptyLabels()` for slicelabel builds; assumes concrete type. |
| mimir | pkg/util/limiter/compat_stringlabels_test.go | Uses reflection/unsafe to inspect `labels.Labels` internal data pointers; will break. |
| mimir | pkg/util/limiter/series_labels_deduplicator.go | Deduplicates `labels.Labels` and may iterate/copy assuming slice; needs accessor-based changes. |
| loki | pkg/logql/log/labels.go | Core Loki label builder/cache built on `labels.Labels`; must be refactored to use new accessors. |
| loki | pkg/logql/log/labels_slicelabels.go | Hashing helper compiled under slicelabels build; assumes slice layout. |
| loki | pkg/logql/log/labels_stringlabels.go | Hashing helper for other builds; must align with new API. |
| tempo | modules/generator/registry/builder.go | Pooled Prometheus `labels.Builder`; any direct slice use of built Labels must switch to accessors after the change. |

These are the highest-risk touchpoints for changing `labels.Labels` from a slice to a named struct with private fields; all must be updated to use the new accessor methods and avoid unsafe pointer/slice assumptions.

SUMMARY: Changing the Labels type from a sorted slice to a named struct with private fields will break any code that directly iterates, indexes, or performs unsafe pointer conversions on it. This change requires refactoring across the Prometheus core and downstream consumers like Grafana Mimir, Loki, and Tempo to use new accessor methods instead of slice operations. The impact is widespread as Labels is a fundamental type used throughout the observability stack.

FILES:
- prometheus/model/labels/labels_slicelabels.go — Core slice-based Labels type; changing its shape breaks all direct slice uses.
- prometheus/model/labels/labels_common.go — Defines Label and Builder APIs that rely on slice semantics.
- prometheus/model/labels/labels_stringlabels.go — Alternative string-encoded implementation that must align with the new struct API.
- prometheus/model/labels/labels_dedupelabels.go — Symbol-table implementation that must align with the new struct API.
- prometheus/model/labels/labels_test.go — Tests assume slice layout and will need updates.
- prometheus/model/labels/matcher.go — Consumes Labels via public API; needs compatibility with the new struct.
- mimir/pkg/mimirpb/compat_stringlabels.go — Uses unsafe pointer casts between protobuf and Labels; will break when Labels is no longer a slice.
- mimir/pkg/streamingpromql/testutils/compat_fixup_labels_slice.go — Relies on concrete Labels type for nil metric fixes.
- mimir/pkg/util/limiter/compat_stringlabels_test.go — Uses reflection/unsafe to inspect Labels internal data; will break.
- mimir/pkg/util/limiter/series_labels_deduplicator.go — May iterate/copy Labels assuming slice layout; needs accessor-based changes.
- loki/pkg/logql/log/labels.go — Core Loki label management built on Labels; must be refactored for new accessors.
- loki/pkg/logql/log/labels_slicelabels.go — Hashing helper compiled under slicelabels build; assumes slice layout.
- loki/pkg/logql/log/labels_stringlabels.go — Hashing helper for other builds; must align with new API.
- tempo/modules/generator/registry/builder.go — Uses Prometheus labels.Builder; any direct slice use of built Labels must switch to accessors.
